text:
Alyssa: IncBot just paged oncall for a spike in customer-facing inference errors — lots of 5xx and timeouts from the embedding route. @Mike can you pick this up?
IncBot: ALERT: inference.errors.rate (prod) > 15/min for 10m — paging eng-oncall | link: https://redwood.infra/alerts/inf-errs-1847654321 :rotating_light:
Mike: Got it, looking. Seeing p95 latency jump to ~1.6s for /v1/embeddings, errors concentrated in eu-west-1.
Jordan: Adding context — we pushed canary model v2.3 last night on a small pool. Could be rollout-related.
Tanvi: Oncall taking handoff. I'll mute noisy low-priority alerts and keep P1s. Can someone post a quick customer-impact summary?
Sara: Quick snapshot: 8 customer requests had >10s failures in the last 15m, several retries visible in gateway logs. No billing impact yet but UX is degraded for a handful of customers.
Mike: Rolling traffic off canary -> switching routing policy to stable models in eu-west-1 now: `rb set-route --service embeddings --region eu-west-1 --policy stable`
Jordan: Noted. Also warming KV cache after rollback: `infra cache warm --model text-embedding-3b --region eu-west-1`
IncBot: ACTION: incident acknowledged by Tanvi. Paging suppressed for non-sev alerts for 15m.
Tanvi: Throttling retries at the gateway to cut amplification: `rate_limit: retries_per_minute: 6` — applied.
Mike: Errors dropping. p95 trending down to 700ms. Good sign.
Sara: Customer-impact note for postmortem: 6 customers hit intermittent errors, 2 had session timeouts. Logged by support under ticket RDC-1427.
Tanvi: OK, immediate mitigation done. We should update alerting to reduce noise and avoid a pagerstorm when cache flushes or transient canary issues happen. Proposals below.
Alyssa: Proposed alert changes (short):
- Add 'deployment != canary' tag to infra.alerts for request_error_rate (only page prod stable).
- Increase p95 threshold for embeddings in prod from 1000ms -> 1400ms to avoid noisy pages during autoscale.
- Add a customer-impact dashboard tile to separate structural errors vs single-customer spikes.
Mike: +1 on dashboards. Current panels mix aggregate and tail which hides per-customer blast radius. New panel should show top 5 affected customer_ids, error rate and retry counts. Example link: https://redwood.infra/dashboards/embeddings-ops?panel=customer-impact
Jordan: For alerts, recommend adding a squelch window: suppress paging if error rate spike resolves within 3m and no increase in 5xx ratio. Also require min_affected_customers >=3 to page.
Tanvi: I can update rules. Draft rule snippet I'm going to add:```
alert: EmbeddingErrorRate
expr: increase(inference_errors_total[5m]) > 15
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: P1
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/oncall/embedding-errors
  owners: eng-oncall
  min_affected_customers: 3
```
Sara: Please include a fallback notification to the dedicated reliability channel (eng-sre) if runbook steps fail or if errors persist >30m.
Alyssa: Runbook updates needed: add steps for rollback, cache warming commands, explicit dashboard links, and ownership for the 'squelch' rule. Current runbook is here: https://redwood.runbooks/oncall/embedding-errors (outdated).
Mike: I'll take the runbook PR. Plan: create PR with annotated changes + example queries and screenshots of the new dashboard tile.
Tanvi: Assigning action items: 1) Mike — runbook PR + link (due EOD). 2) Jordan — add min_affected_customers check to alert rule (in prometheus) and create test alert (due tomorrow). 3) Alyssa — dashboard tile and panels for per-customer impact (due EOD). 4) Sara — customer support summary + add RDC-1427 link to runbook (done).
IncBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Errors normalized. Incident resolved at 1847654800 — sla unaffected.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident closed by Tanvi (oncall) — duration 8m 19s.
Tanvi: Post-incident note — we'll schedule a 30min triage tomorrow 10:00 to validate thresholds and confirm no regressions in canary logic. Invite: https://calendar.redwood/meet/triage-embeddings-1847654321
Mike: One more: add an annotated timeline to the runbook with the commands we ran and links to logs: https://logs.redwood/trace/1847654321
Jordan: Also add an ownership line in the runbook: `owner: eng-oncall` and a contact rotation (pager) variable.
Alyssa: Leaving a quick PR template snippet for runbook updates:```
## After-action edits
- Summary of incident & impact
- Prometheus rule diffs (with rationale)
- Dashboard panels added (panel ids)
- Owner and oncall rotation contact
- Follow-up tickets: RDC-1428 (alert tune), RDC-1429 (dashboard refinement)
```
Sara: Marking support ticket RDC-1427 as related in runbook. Will add customer quotes to postmortem doc.
Tanvi: Thanks everyone. Closing the oncall thread — follow-ups in RDC-1428/RDC-1429 and the runbook PR link will go in this thread when available. :white_check_mark:
